experiment: V3 evaluation diagnostics v4, no recognition changes

candidatePitchPrecision.evidenceLevel: Agreement with unreviewed candidate XML, not source-certified precision.

evidenceLevels.headDetectionAndFill: Frozen single-AI source observations, not independently certified.
evidenceLevels.shape: Source shape strata versus native labels; ordinary BLACK/VOID do not distinguish round/square/diamond. No four-shape accuracy claim.
evidenceLevels.timingAndExport: Graph scheduling and unique layout witnesses, not source-correct pitch/duration or proof of deletion when ambiguous.
evidenceLevels.candidateXmlAgreement: Unreviewed XML; retained as historical proxy, not gold-source accuracy.
evidenceLevels.generalization: Not measured. All diagnostics use previously exposed training material.
evidenceLevels.templatePairs: Equal logged slim-box center, orientation, anchor and seed path; not forced source-center or identical internal anchor-coordinate evaluations. Correlated proposal counts are not independent observations.

negativeDiagnostic.reason: Error-directed point negatives do not supply a population precision denominator.
